pages.text: Drops fell from the roof edge. Melting snow revealed the alley floor.
Nono was playing marbles. Kiki wanted to join.
Kiki's first marble rolled the wrong way.
Gugu laughed. Kiki's hands froze on the knees. "I cannot do it."
Nono offered a marble. Kiki did not reach for it.
The other two rolled marbles happily. Kiki sat apart with clenched fists.
The days grew longer, and so did their games. No marble left a mark in Kiki's palm.
Grandpa Badger said, "My very first marble went under that wall."
Kiki opened a hand. "Let me try once more."
The marble rolled well. All three lay side by side, rolling their marbles.
